format.rgb: frames/NNNNN.png, uint8 H x W x 3, 240 x 320, sRGB, head camera after sensor noise
format.npz_depth: frames/NNNNN.npz['depth'], float16 H x W, metres along the optical axis (distance_to_image_plane) after sensor noise; non-finite where there is no return
format.npz_instance_ids: frames/NNNNN.npz['instance_ids'], int32 H x W, Isaac instance_id_segmentation_fast ids; frames.jsonl row 'instance_id_to_prim' maps an id (string) to its prim path for the placed instances; 0 and ids of the robot or the shell are not listed

frames.jsonl row.sim_time_s: simulated seconds since the item began
frames.jsonl row.odometry_pose: [x, y, yaw] the AGENT's odometry estimate (oracle-assisted with noise), metres and radians, in the odometry frame whose origin is the start pose
frames.jsonl row.true_pose: [x, y, yaw] torso pose in the world frame (EVALUATION ONLY)
frames.jsonl row.true_camera: world pose of the head camera (EVALUATION ONLY): position (m), forward and up unit vectors, fovy_deg, aspect; right = forward x up; world frame z up
frames.jsonl row.true_room_id: composed homes only: generator room id at the robot (EVALUATION ONLY)
frames.jsonl row.gt: per visible placed instance (EVALUATION ONLY): class, pixel count and tight 2D box [x1, y1, x2, y2] in pixels (x1, y1 inclusive, x2, y2 exclusive) from the segmentation, keyed by instance id of scene_truth.json

format.intrinsics: pinhole, fx = fy = (H/2) / tan(fovy/2) with fovy 58 degrees, cx = W/2, cy = H/2, principal point at pixel centres of a 320 x 240 image; stored per item in the run result JSON under 'intrinsics'
format.frame_conventions: world: z up, metres; image origin top-left, x right, y down; camera optical axis = forward, up as given; head camera pitched 35 degrees down on the torso
format.hires: capture-only second render product of the same head camera at 640 x 480, rendered from the identical pose right after the 320 x 240 frame: frames_hires/NNNNN.png (uint8 480 x 640 x 3), frames_hires/NNNNN.npz (depth float16 metres, instance_ids int32), frames.jsonl keys gt_hires, instance_id_to_prim_hires, png_hires_sha256; intrinsics scale with the resolution (fx = fy = 240 / tan(fovy/2) at 640 x 480, cx = 320, cy = 240); the agent's camera stays 320 x 240; each row has 'resolution': base and hires [w, h]
format.no_model_output: Qwen3-VL is not run during capture; detector comparison is offline
